Interface AnnotationBuilder<A extends Annotation>

Type Parameters:
A - The annotation type
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractAnnotationBuilder
public interface AnnotationBuilder<A extends Annotation>
Creates the instances of one annotation type.

A builder is stateless and thread safe, and is meant to be looked up once, with find(Class), and then reused. The implementations are generated at compile time for the types listed in RegisterAnnotations.

A member that is an annotation is read from an AnnotationValue, from a Map of its members or from an instance, and an array of annotations from an array or a collection of those. A member that is a class is read from a Class, an AnnotationClassValue or a class name, and an enum from a constant or its name. Anything else is converted by the conversion service. A member that is not given gets the default of the annotation type.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
